newsitem.title: USA: Clinton won't sign US tax bill with indexing-Rubin.
newsitem.headline: Clinton won't sign US tax bill with indexing-Rubin.

text.p: President Clinton wants tax cuts but will not sign legislation that includes "indexing," of capital gains for inflation, Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Wednesday.

House and Senate Republican leaders and tax negotiators have worked out a unified position on tax legislation that includes a capital gains indexing provision which would account for inflation when calculating the tax on profits on investments.
"The president has said that he will not sign a bill with indexing," Rubin said.

"The president wants to put in place a tax cut program ... on the other hand there are serious issues ... we want to work with Republicans to get a bill that we are all comfortable with and that are consistent with his (Clinton's) principles," Rubin told reporters after speaking to House Democrats.
